name: 5000 Rummy
summary: North American rummy where a face-up card determines hand size, dealer's upcard is wild, and multiple discard cards can be taken.
rules_text: 3-8 players use 1-2 decks. Each player gets one face-up card; its rank sets hand size: number = pip, 10 for J/Q/K, 11 for A. Dealer's upcard is wild for the hand. Stock and discard pile are formed. On a turn you must draw: either top of stock or top discard, or several discards if you meld the deepest taken immediately and take all cards above it. Then you may meld sets of 3+ equal ranks and runs of 3+ consecutive same suit (A high/low) and add to any player's melds. Wilds substitute anywhere. If you meld the natural card for a wild in a run, you place it in front of you but wild stays. If a discard is playable on any existing meld, any melded player may call 'rummy' out of turn to take and meld it. End turn discarding one unplayable card. If you have no cards after melding you float, must draw from stock only. Hand ends when someone goes out with an unplayable discard or stock empties. Melds score: A/wilds 100, face/10 is 10, 2-9 is 5; going out also scores opponents' unmelded cards. First to 5000 wins.
rating_reason: Specific rummy game, hidden hands, draw discard
